execution_overview.overall_summary: Built a Python-based Docker image and executed non-parametric correlation analyses for both tasks. After repairing command-line argument handling and a syntax error in the Python scripts, both tasks ran successfully. Results show strong, significant negative associations between life history strategy (Mini-K and HKSS totals) and psychopathology (DSM5 total), including partial Spearman controlling for Age and Sex, supporting the focal claim.

deviations.description: Created Python translations for JASP analyses and added default CLI arguments to the scripts so they run without explicit --data/--out.
deviations.reason: The orchestrator executes entry scripts without arguments; original JASP code was not directly runnable.

method_fidelity.fidelity_note: Followed the planned non-parametric correlations (Spearman primary, Kendall sensitivity) and included partial Spearman with Age and Sex as covariates.

test_statistics.other: Spearman(DSM5_Total, HKSS_Total). Also observed Spearman(DSM5, MiniK) = -0.5896 (p=2.77e-14); Kendall(DSM5, MiniK) = -0.4314 (p=2.16e-13); Kendall(DSM5, HKSS) = -0.3735 (p=2.05e-10). Partial Spearman (controlling Age, Sex): DSM5~MiniK r=-0.4726 (p=6.28e-09), DSM5~HKSS r=-0.4024 (p=1.19e-06).

result_raw.result_text: Psychopathology (DSM5 total) is negatively correlated with life history strategy totals (HKSS and Mini-K), with very small p-values; the association remains negative controlling for Age and Sex.

conclusion.conclusion_text: The negative correlations indicate that slower life history strategy (higher HKSS/Mini-K) is associated with lower psychopathology (DSM5 total), supporting the focal claim.

deviations.description: Created Python translation and added default CLI arguments for Kendall’s tau between DSM5_Total and MiniK_Total.
deviations.reason: Original JASP analysis not directly executable; orchestrator executes without arguments.

method_fidelity.fidelity_note: Executed Kendall’s tau (primary) and Spearman (supplemental) between DSM5_Total and MiniK_Total as planned.

test_statistics.other: Kendall tau-b between DSM5_Total and MiniK_Total; Spearman r_s = -0.5896 (p=2.77e-14).

result_raw.result_text: Kendall’s tau indicates a strong negative association between DSM5 total and Mini-K total.

conclusion.conclusion_text: The negative Kendall’s tau supports the focal claim that higher (slower) life history strategy is associated with fewer psychopathology symptoms.
